assets.localAlt: Four fictional adult women laugh and link hands on a railed overlook above Gobustan mud volcanoes and the distant Caspian Sea. Copper, silver, turquoise and cobalt outfits are paired with gold, red, black and silver boots; the woman at right holds a blue prism.

Four fictional adult women link hands on a wooden overlook above Gobustan mud volcanoes. The woman in a cobalt mini-dress kisses the cheek of the woman in a black jacket and turquoise skirt, while their companions in copper and silver smile. Blue prism accessories and four different pairs of boots are visible.

Four fictional adult women huddle and smile on Baku's wet waterfront at blue hour, with the Flame Towers and marina behind them. Red fabric sweeps to the left, beside cobalt, turquoise and copper outfits and white, blue, copper and silver knee boots.

Close portrait of four fictional adult women beneath a Sheki stone arch. One kisses her blonde companion's cheek while touching a blue collar detail; the other two smile and clasp hands below. Red, black, turquoise and amber clothing fills the foreground, with tiled roofs and green mountains behind.
